title: My Portfolio
line: The website you are on right now!
problem: A webpage portfolio showcasing my work in software development, design, entrepreneurship and more. My previous portfolio had too many pages with too much content on each one.
did: As the solo software developer and UI/UX designer, I redesigned the whole website around a cleaner layout and rebuilt it from scratch with Next.js, Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion. I designed the UI, developed reusable components, implemented the animations and set up a CMS so I can update my content easily.
outcome: A cleaner website that presents my projects in a clear and visually appealing way. Feel free to explore!
